PREFIX brick: <http://data.brickv1.org/schema/>
PREFIX ref: <http://example.org/ref/>
SELECT ?zone_name ?zone ?tsid WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone .
  ?zone brick:hasSubCategory ?s .
  ?point a brick:AirTemperatureSensor ; brick:hasPrimaryPointOf ?p ; brick:pointOf ?zone .
  ?p a brick:AirTemperature .
  ?point ref:hasExternalReference ?ext .
  ?ext ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
  ?zone rdfs:label ?zone_name .
} LIMIT 50
